en.name: Kopi Sore Brown Sugar Latte
en.note: 3-in-1 sachet, 1,500 kg first batch, launched in 7 weeks.
en.need: A new coffee brand wanted a brown sugar latte sachet that tastes like a cafe drink and dissolves in cold or hot water.
en.concept: A creamy brown sugar latte with a medium coffee note, sold in a 10-sachet display box.
en.challenge: The first samples separated and left sediment in cold water.
en.solution: We changed the creamer base and the particle size of the sugar, then ran two more sample rounds until the drink stayed smooth.
en.result: The approved formula passed three consecutive production batches with the same taste and dissolving time.

id.name: Kopi Sore Brown Sugar Latte
id.note: Sachet 3-in-1, batch pertama 1.500 kg, meluncur dalam 7 minggu.
id.need: Sebuah brand kopi baru menginginkan sachet latte brown sugar yang rasanya seperti minuman kafe dan larut dalam air dingin maupun panas.
id.concept: Latte brown sugar yang creamy dengan sentuhan kopi sedang, dijual dalam boks display isi 10 sachet.
id.challenge: Sampel awal memisah dan meninggalkan endapan di air dingin.
id.solution: Kami mengganti basis krimer dan ukuran partikel gula, lalu menjalankan dua putaran sampel lagi sampai minuman tetap halus.
id.result: Formula yang disetujui lolos tiga batch produksi berturut-turut dengan rasa dan waktu larut yang sama.
